securityPage.headline: What we do, and what we don't claim.
securityPage.sub: Both halves of this page matter. The second one is the reason to believe the first.

controls.title: Tenant isolation
controls.body: Every tenant table carries an organisation id, and row-level security policies scope reads to the organisation on your profile. Privileged background writes go through a separate client that must name the organisation explicitly.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.body: TLS in transit. Data at rest is encrypted by our database provider. Per-tenant channel credentials — bot tokens, access tokens — are encrypted with a separate key before they are stored, and are never readable from the browser.

controls.title: Authenticated webhooks
controls.body: Inbound webhooks are verified before their body is parsed: Meta's signature for Instagram, a per-connection secret token for Telegram. Requests that fail verification are rejected, not logged and processed.

controls.title: Spend caps
controls.body: Each workspace has a hard cap. On reaching it we pause the line rather than continue billing — enforced in the platform itself, not in a spreadsheet. Pausing actually stops inbound calls; it is not a flag we check later.

controls.title: Your data stays yours
controls.body: Calls, transcripts, contacts and appointments belong to your workspace. You can export them, and deleting your account deletes them.

controls.title: Access control
controls.body: The operator console is separate from the customer application and behind its own authentication. Customer sessions can never reach it.

securityPage.notClaimedHeadline: The things we can't say yet.

notClaimed.title: We are not SOC 2 certified.
notClaimed.body: Not yet, and we will not imply otherwise. If your procurement needs a report today, we are the wrong vendor right now — tell us and we will say so.

notClaimed.title: We are not HIPAA compliant.
notClaimed.body: Do not route protected health information through Denku. Booking a dental appointment is fine; clinical detail is not.

notClaimed.title: We have no third-party penetration test to show.
notClaimed.body: When we commission one, the result goes on this page whichever way it reads.

principles.title: A call never dead-ends.
principles.body: Every finished call produces something — a ticket or an appointment request — even when the AI never reaches for a tool. It is a guarantee in the pipeline, not a prompt we hope holds.

principles.title: We fail closed on money.
principles.body: Gating checks fail open so a paying customer is never locked out. Billing writes fail closed so nothing is ever guessed. When those two conflict, money loses.

principles.title: Everything can happen twice.
principles.body: Webhooks retry. Networks repeat themselves. Every write path is built to be run again without doing damage — that is why a retried call does not create two appointments.

principles.title: We say what isn't built.
principles.body: Channels in beta are labelled beta. Certifications we don't hold are named on the security page. We removed compliance claims from this site that we could not stand behind.

docsPage.outputTitle: What you get after every conversation
docsPage.outputSub: The AI never just takes a message and loses it. Every finished conversation becomes something you can act on.

outputs.title: A request, or an appointment
outputs.description: A task with the detail the caller gave, or a booking request with the time they asked for. If the AI did not create one during the conversation, the system creates it afterwards from the transcript — a conversation is never lost.

outputs.title: A customer record
outputs.description: Everyone it speaks to is saved, with their history across every channel. The next call starts from something rather than from zero.

outputs.title: The recording and the transcript
outputs.description: Attached to the conversation, so you can hear exactly what was said rather than take our word for what it heard.

outputs.title: An email when something needs you
outputs.description: You are told when a new request or appointment lands, at the address you choose — not your personal inbox unless you say so.

docsPage.knowledgeSub: The AI never invents a fact it was not given. Anything you leave blank becomes a request for you instead of an answer — which is safe, but it is not what you are paying for.

knowledgePoints.title: Fill in what it should know
knowledgePoints.description: What you sell, your hours, your service area, your booking and cancellation rules, the questions you are asked most, and the tone you want.

knowledgePoints.title: Or upload what you already have
knowledgePoints.description: A price list, a services page, a policy document. We read it and fill in what it says, leaving the rest blank rather than guessing.

knowledgePoints.title: You review before it is saved
knowledgePoints.description: Denku can draft those fields from your website, but the draft is always shown for you to correct — anything in there is said to your customers as though you had said it.

docsPage.languagesSub: It speaks and listens in these, on calls and in chat. In chat it replies in whichever language the customer writes in.
docsPage.languagesNote: A call starts in the employee's main language and switches if the caller speaks another one you have ticked.
docsPage.sensesTitle: What it can read and hear
docsPage.sensesSub: On chat channels, a customer does not have to type.

senses.title: Photos
senses.description: A customer sends a picture of the part, the damage or the label, and the AI reads what is in it and answers.

senses.title: Voice notes
senses.description: A voice message is heard and answered as if it had been typed.

senses.title: And when it can't
senses.description: If a file cannot be read, it says so rather than guessing at what was in it.

docsPage.takeoverBody: On chat channels, every conversation lives in one Inbox and you can take it over and reply yourself; the AI stops answering that conversation until you hand it back.
docsPage.takeoverCaveat: On a phone call it cannot transfer the caller to a person mid-call. It takes the message and creates a request so someone calls back.
docsPage.hoursBody: Denku answers around the clock, on every channel, at every hour. Opening hours describe when your staff are in — they never stop the AI from answering.
docsPage.hoursCaveat: You choose whether it mentions that you are currently closed before carrying on and helping fully, or simply does not raise it.
docsPage.storeBody: Denku can read an e-commerce catalogue so the AI answers product questions — what exists, what it costs, and what is in stock, down to the colour and size. IdeaSoft is the first system supported. The customer still talks on your website or Telegram; the product facts come from your store.
docsPage.storeCaveat: This is built but has not yet run against a real store, so we set it up with you and verify it together. Order lookup — “where is my order” — is deliberately not available, because an anonymous visitor must never be able to read a stranger's order.

faqs.question: How long does setup take?
faqs.answer: The guided setup is a few minutes and a number from us is live the same day. Your own number takes as long as your carrier needs to point it at us. Teaching the AI about your business is done afterwards and improves at any time.

faqs.question: Can I keep my existing number?
faqs.answer: Yes, without porting it away from your carrier. Your carrier forwards calls for that number to us over a SIP trunk and the AI answers. Netgsm is proven and has a ready-made preset; any other carrier works in principle but we set it up with you rather than leaving it self-serve.

faqs.question: What happens if it doesn't know the answer?
faqs.answer: It says so and creates a request for you, with what the customer asked. It will not invent an answer. That is the behaviour to design around: the more you put in Knowledge, the fewer of those you get.

faqs.question: Do you read my email?
faqs.answer: Only what you forward. You forward a published address such as info@ to an address we issue you — we never ask for your mailbox password and we never see anything you do not forward. Forwarding also brings nothing from the past: only mail arriving after you switch the rule on appears.

faqs.question: Can it send email as my own domain?
faqs.answer: Once you publish the DNS records we give you. Until then it receives, reads and drafts, and a person sends. There is no fallback to a Denku address, because a reply from a stranger's domain is worse than no reply.

faqs.question: Is there an API?
faqs.answer: Not yet. Denku is used through the dashboard and the channels above. If you need something integrated, tell us what and we will say honestly whether it exists.

docsPage.ctaBody: Ask the AI on our own site — it answers from the same facts this page is written from — or write to a person.

supportPage.answerBody: A person reads every email and answers it. Anything that stops customers reaching you — a line not ringing, a channel gone silent — comes first.
supportPage.answerHonesty: There is no support tier to buy and no contractual response time. We are not big enough to promise one, and we would rather say that than print a number we might miss.
supportPage.fixesTitle: Things that most often go wrong

fixes.q: A brand-new number does not ring yet
fixes.a: The phone network takes a minute or two to publish a new number before calls can reach it. Nothing is lost — the number stays yours and starts answering the moment the carrier finishes. If it is still silent after ten minutes, write to us.

fixes.q: My own number reaches you but matches nothing
fixes.a: Almost always the number format. Your carrier must send the caller and called numbers in full international format. Check the prefixes in your carrier panel, and that the SIP server is a numeric IP address rather than a hostname.

fixes.q: The chat widget does not appear on my site
fixes.a: The widget only runs on the domains you listed when you installed it, and an empty list refuses everywhere. Add every address the site is served from, including the builder preview domain on Shopify, Wix or Squarespace.

Check the forwarding rule is switched on and confirmed at your mail host — Gmail asks for a confirmation. Remember that forwarding brings nothing from before you switched it on, so send a fresh test message from another account.

fixes.q: The Telegram bot receives but does not answer
fixes.a: Either the workspace has no chat plan, or the bot is not assigned to an AI employee. Both are shown on the channel's own page in your dashboard.

fixes.q: The AI keeps saying it does not know
fixes.a: That is the design — it never invents an answer. Fill in the Knowledge section for the employee, or upload a price list or services page, and it will answer those itself instead of turning them into requests for you.

fixes.q: A question about an invoice or minutes
fixes.a: Billing, usage and every past invoice are in Settings → Billing. If a figure looks wrong, send us the invoice reference and we will explain exactly how it was calculated.

supportPage.statusBody: There is no public status page yet. If Denku is not answering for you, write to us and say so — that is the fastest signal we get, and we will tell you what we find.
supportPage.ctaBody: Your workspace name, the channel, and roughly when. That is usually enough for us to find it in the logs.
